                batch_x = batch_x.to(device)

                outputs, _ = model(batch_x)
                forecast = outputs[:, -CONFIG["pred_len"]:, :]
                loss = criterion(forecast, batch_y)
                val_loss += loss.item() * batch_x.size(0)
        val_loss /= len(val_loader.dataset)

        early_stopping(val_loss, model, ckpt_dir)
        if early_stopping.early_stop:
            break

    # Load best model
    best_path = os.path.join(ckpt_dir, "checkpoint.pth")
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(best_path, map_location=device))
    model.eval()

    # Predictor closure
    def predictor(history, *, calendar=None):
        # history: [720, 7] numpy array
        hist = history[-CONFIG["seq_len"]:, :]  # crop to seq_len
        if calendar is not None:
            cal = calendar[-CONFIG["seq_len"]:, :]  # crop similarly (unused)
        else:
            cal = None
        tensor = torch.from_numpy(hist).float().unsqueeze(0).to(device)  # [1, seq_len, 7]
        with torch.no_grad():
            out, _ = model(tensor)          # [1, seq_len+pred_len, 7]
            fore = out[:, -CONFIG["pred_len"]:, :].squeeze(0).cpu().numpy()  # [pred_len, 7]
        return fore

    return predictor
}

Our harness recomputes the claim metric from the same agent predictions on the test windows a loader with drop_last=True keeps (batch sizes 32, 64, 128, 256, or only the size named in the quote), for every valid main seed. effect = |truncated mean - full mean| (same seeds). bestaetigt if at least 2 valid seeds and the largest effect >= tolerance / 4; widerlegt if at least 2 valid seeds and all effects < tolerance / 4; offen otherwise.
